GDPR.name: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)
GDPR.why: The product processes personal data or health data.
GDPR.next_steps: Review lawful basis, data minimisation, user rights, and security measures.

MDR.name: Medical Device Regulation (MDR)
MDR.why: The product may have a medical purpose.
MDR.next_steps: Review intended use, medical claims, risk classification, and whether expert assessment is needed.

Patientdatalagen.name: Patientdatalagen (Patient Data Act)
Patientdatalagen.why: The product may handle patient records or healthcare information in Sweden.
Patientdatalagen.next_steps: Review access control, logging, patient record handling, and data storage requirements.

HSL.name: Hälso- och sjukvårdslagen
HSL.why: The product may support healthcare services in Sweden.
HSL.next_steps: Review how the product supports quality, continuity, and safe healthcare delivery.

Patientsäkerhetslagen.name: Patientsäkerhetslagen
Patientsäkerhetslagen.why: Mistakes in the product could affect patient safety.
Patientsäkerhetslagen.next_steps: Review risk management, incident handling, and clinical safety considerations.

OSL.name: Offentlighets- och sekretesslagen
OSL.why: The product may handle confidential patient information.
OSL.next_steps: Review confidentiality, authorization, and secure access to patient information.

AI_ACT.name: EU Artificial Intelligence Act
AI_ACT.why: The product uses AI for decision-making.
AI_ACT.next_steps: Review transparency, human oversight, and whether the AI system may be high-risk.
